snippet.title: Dead To Rights: Retribution - PS3 - X360 - GAC Pack DLC
snippet.description:
Dead To Rights: Retribution GAC PACK Downloadable Content Video
 
Check out the video to see a preview of the new action-packed "GAC Pack" downloadable content (DLC) now available in PAL territories via Xbox Live® Marketplace for Xbox 360® and PlayStation® Network for PlayStation®3.

This new premium DLC pack includes two new and completely different modes of gameplay, plus exciting bonus options to extend the experience beyond the core retail game. 

"Assault on the 87th Precinct" is a new mission that reveals a flip side to the story, letting players experience the action from the GAC (Grant City Anti-Crime) enemy's side of the battle. Players step into the boots of the GAC Sniper, Brawler and Tank characters as they converge on the GCPD (Grant City Police Department) stronghold under orders to contain all police officers so they can secure a tactical advantage. In "Riot Control Mode," Jack and Shadow fend off increasingly difficult waves of GAC forces to earn points and achievements based on speed and style, with high score bragging rights on international leaderboards. In addition, the previously exclusive "Jack Pack" and "Shadow Pack" are included in the "GAC Pack" allowing players to access armour for Jack, stealth camouflage for Shadow. The pack also contains an "action mode" which offers gunplay with explosive rounds, and a "noir mode" with a stylish black, white and red graphic filter. 

Dead to Rights: Retribution is now available at your local game stores on PS3 and X360 !

For more information, visit the game's official:
- Facebook Page: http://www.facebook.com/pages/Dead-To-Rights-The-Official-page/326149796290
- Website: http://deadtorights.com/

heck out your local Namco Bandai website for more information on our other titles: http://www.namcobandaigames.eu/
